title: Copyright trolling: the experience of HE and related organisations
content:
In January 2026, Tim Riley (University of Aberdeen) and Liesl Rowe (Leeds Beckett University) presented a closed webinar on the ongoing problem of copyright trolling to the copyright literacy community. One common sentiment which emerged from the webinar was that there is a lot of uncertainty around the scale of copyright trolling and how the sector generally chooses to handle these requests. To build up a more accurate picture, Tim and Liesl ran a survey. 36 organisations responded, both from within the UK and internationally. You can read the report here:

The consistent thread throughout the report is that copyright trolling is a common issue and there is a general lack of clarity about how to handle these requests. Talking about these issues helps us all as a sector refine our views and raise awareness. To assist with this, Tim and Liesl will be joining Jane and Chris for another webinar on Friday 30th October to discuss our next steps and to ascertain what areas the community would particularly like help with. We would love it if you could join us. You can register for the webinar here.
